卫星电视的影响正日益扩大。

zh: 不确定的；不肯定的；暂定的
踌躇的；犹豫不定的；不果断的
en: not definite or certain because you may want to change it later
ex: We made a tentative arrangement to meet on Friday.
我们暂定星期五见面。

zh: 不确定的；不肯定的；暂定的
踌躇的；犹豫不定的；不果断的
en: in a way that is not definite or certain because you may want to change it later
ex: They have tentatively agreed to our proposal.
他们已初步同意我们的提议。

zh: 不确定的；不肯定的；暂定的
踌躇的；犹豫不定的；不果断的
en: the state of not being definite or certain because you may want to change it later
ex: The reason for the tentativeness of these conclusions is clear.
这些结论暂定的原因是显而易见的。

zh: 由帐篷组成的；帐篷状的
en: consisting of tents; like a tent
ex: a tented village
帐篷村

en: 10th
ex: Today is the tenth (of May).
今天是十月（五月）。

en: so weak or uncertain that it hardly exists
ex: a tenuous hold on life
命若游丝

en: in a way that is so weak or uncertain that it hardly exists
ex: This plot device is only tenuously connected to the rest of the movie.
该绘图设备仅与电影的其余部分牢固地连接。

zh: （尤指重要政治职务的）任期，任职
（尤指大学教师的）终身职位，长期聘用
en: the period of time when somebody holds an important job, especially a political one; the act of holding an important job
ex: his four-year tenure as president
他的四年总统任期

zh: 获终身聘用的；享有终身职位的
en: that you can keep permanently
ex: a tenured post
终身职位

zh: （美洲印第安人旧时使用的）圆锥形帐篷
en: a type of tall tent like a cone in shape, used by Native Americans in the past

zh: 不冷不热的；微温的；温吞的
en: slightly warm, sometimes in a way that is not pleasant
ex: tepid tea
温吞的茶

zh: 龙舌兰酒，特奎拉酒（墨西哥产的一种烈性酒）
en: a strong alcoholic drink made in Mexico from a tropical plant
